description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_oci8' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to handle data dictionary operations for Oracle databases using OCI8. It includes methods for type mapping, SQL generation for schema modifications, triggers for auto-increment emulation, and index/comment management specific to Oracle.

classes.name: ADODB2_oci8
classes.description: Class for Oracle OCI8-specific Data Dictionary operations, including schema creation, modification, auto-increment triggers, and type mapping.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types to Oracle-specific meta types based on length and object properties.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal meta type codes back to Oracle data types.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a new Oracle user/schema.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for adding columns to an existing table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for altering columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for dropping columns from a table.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop an auto-increment sequence.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Builds SQL suffix for column creation including default, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _Triggers
methods.description: Creates triggers to emulate auto-increment behavior in Oracle.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements for index creation or replacement.

methods.name: GetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to retrieve column comments.

methods.name: SetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to set comments on columns.
